title: Move Tensor to GPU (if available)
description: Create a 2x4 tensor of ones, move it to GPU if available, and print the resulting device.
problemStatement:
Write code that:
1. Creates a 2x4 tensor filled with ones.
2. Checks if a GPU is available. If yes, moves the tensor to the GPU and prints the new device. If not, prints the string 'GPU not available'.

The output must match the expected format exactly.
expectedOutput: cuda:0   (or 'GPU not available' if no GPU)
solutionCode:
import torch

t = torch.ones(2, 4)
if torch.cuda.is_available():
    t = t.to('cuda')
    print(t.device)
else:
    print('GPU not available')
